text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Un peu de silence ! Let us begin today's 
lecture, everyone~♪

I heard about a lecture the students call 
"Laurel-sensei's French Class," and got 
curious enough to attend, but...
choice_data_list: To think there are this many students...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The eyes of the condor soaring across the 
world have France firmly in their sights, 
dess!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Laurel-san, you're very popular because of 
how gently you teach everyone, you know? 
Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Across the vast ocean lies a foreign land 
with the scent of "romance"—and I'm gonna 
carve out the sea route to it!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Tactics are all about feints, y'know? No 
point in blabbering on in plain Japanese.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you're super interested in 
France today too! I'll do my best as your 
teacher.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Now then, in preparation for our overseas 
trip, let's learn all about French culture 
today~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Tap-chan. You've entered a 
clothing store in France. What do you do?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ha, that's completely obvious. If you were 
a clerk—take a look over here.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Which one's the flashiest outfit worthy of 
me?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, that's a straightforward 
question! Though, it'd be even better if 
you greeted them first.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
France is a country that really values 
etiquette! If you start with a "Bonjour" 
greeting, they'll treat you with great 
care and hospitality♪

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ha, what a remarkably well-mannered 
country.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But the racing world is different... 
right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're quite knowledgeable♪ French 
races are never forgiving, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Like that French racecourse known as the 
'Most Elegant in the World'—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The elevation change is about 10 meters. 
It features a grueling hill unlike 
anything found at racecourses in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh...! In other words, you just need 
a monstrous amount of stamina!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That's right! And going slow at first, 
then making your move at the end is the 
French style!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The sheer passion of the Umamusume 
clashing with everything they've got down 
the long straight reaches me so intensely 
that my heart races!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's not just noble and elegant— it 
possesses a charm that can captivate 
anyone!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, French racing became a 
sanctuary for everyone's hearts because a 
racecourse was born in the Bois de 
Boulogne—!

"Before I knew it, I felt like we were 
drifting further and further away from 
studying French..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! We sure talked a lot, huh? 
Alright, next up is—

I breathe a sigh of relief. Thank 
goodness, it seems they've remembered 
their original purpose.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
For some practical application, want to go 
for a run right now? Over the exact same 
distance as the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!
choice_data_list: This is a French language class, right?!

This is a French language class, isn't 
it?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No-no! France is the world! It defies all 
conventioooon!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"A mock race simulating the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe with our seniors...! Fufu, I'm 
so excited!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The students are full of motivation. As 
Sakura Laurel's trainer, this is where I—"
choice_data_list: Learning French will come in handy!
Let's leave it up to Laurel's pace.

text_block_list.text:
Learning French is a valuable opportunity 
that will definitely pay off in overseas 
races. When I told the girls this--

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, sorry, it just slipped out... 
You're right. Language skills will become 
a powerful weapon someday!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Still, if it's a reward for finishing my 
studies, ...it should be fine, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "Je vous remercie. —Thank you very much♪"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
All right everyone, let's resume our 
French lesson.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay♪ Please take good care of me, 
Laurel-sensei!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
A friendly "ready, set, go" is so boring. 
—If you can't keep up, I'm leaving you 
behind, got it?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You think that's a bluff? Heh, 
interesting... I'll take you up on that 
invitation.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Wait, pleeease! The title of the world's 
strongest belongs to El Cóndor Pasa, you 
know!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That's true... Yeah, I can't afford to 
fall behind either.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Because there are so many other Umamusume 
who share the very same dream as me."
